summary: 선택 템플릿부터 영역·변형 규칙을 정의한다. 모델 전환 조건과 서버 탐색 상한을 명시하고 실패 1·2페이지 검증 후 30페이지로 확장한다.
invariants: Support the selected template first with content slots, layout constraints, design tokens and allowed variations.
Use explicit unresolved-layout reasons and finite server search budgets to admit model calls.
Check template rules on every page and visually review representative dense pages and layout types.
Validate original pages 1 and 2 first, then the same A4 template path across all 30 pages.
forbidden: Treat color and font copying alone as complete template support.
